request.query: The length or coefficient absolute sum of the zero polynomial is zero.

items.informal_name: Gauss Norm of Zero Polynomial is Zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {F : Type u_2} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : FunLike F R ℝ] (v : F) (c : ℝ),
  Polynomial.gaussNorm v c 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any valuation $ v $ on a semiring $ R $ and any real number $ c > 0 $, the Gauss norm of the zero polynomial in $ R[X] $ satisfies $ \|0\|_{v,c} = 0 $. This follows directly from the definition of the Gauss norm, which assigns value 0 to polynomials with empty support (i.e., the zero polynomial).

items.informal_name: Content of the Zero Polynomial is Zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : NormalizedGCDMonoid R], Polynomial.content 0 = 0
items.informal_description: The content of the zero polynomial in the polynomial ring $ R[X] $ is equal to zero, i.e., $\operatorname{content}(0) = 0$.

items.informal_name: Mahler Measure of the Zero Polynomial is Zero
items.informal_description: The Mahler measure of the zero polynomial in the polynomial ring $\mathbb{C}[X]$ is equal to zero, i.e., $\text{mahlerMeasure}(0) = 0$.

items.informal_name: Hilbert Polynomial at Degree Zero is Zero
items.type: ∀ {F : Type u_1} [inst : Field F] (p : Polynomial F), p.hilbertPoly 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any polynomial $ p $, the Hilbert polynomial evaluated at degree 0 is zero, i.e., $ H(p, 0) = 0 $.
For any exponent vector $x$, the zero polynomial evaluated at $x$ is equal to 0, i.e., $0(x) = 0$.

For any non-zero polynomial $ p $ over a normed division ring $ K $, every root $ \alpha $ of $ p $ satisfies $ \|\alpha\| \leq 1 + \frac{\sup_{0 \leq i < \deg p} \|\text{coeff}_i(p)\|}{\|\text{leadingCoeff}(p)\|} $, where the supremum is taken over all non-leading coefficients of $ p $.

items.informal_name: Sum of Zero Polynomial is Zero in Additive Commutative Monoid
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] {S : Type u_1} [inst_1 : AddCommMonoid S] (f : ℕ → R → S), Polynomial.sum 0 f = 0
items.informal_description: For any additive commutative monoid $S$ and function $f : \mathbb{N} \to R \to S$, the sum of the zero polynomial in $R[X]$ evaluated through $f$ equals the zero element of $S$. Formally, $\sum_{n \in \text{support}(0)} f(n)(0) = 0_S$.

items.informal_name: Zero Polynomial Maps to Zero Function under Coefficient Extraction
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (n : ℕ), (Polynomial.toFn n) 0 = 0
items.informal_description: For any natural number $n$ and semiring $R$, the coefficient extraction map $\text{toFn}_n$ sends the zero polynomial in $R[X]$ to the zero function in the space of functions from $\{0, 1, \ldots, n-1\}$ to $R$. In other words, $\text{toFn}_n(0) = 0$, where the left-hand side is the zero polynomial and the right-hand side is the function constant zero on all indices $0 \leq i < n$.
